corrections.text: The headline says an IDC analyst 'Asks for Benchmarks'. TechTarget reports that Stewart Bond 'suggested that Confluent provide evidence of the efficacy' of Lightning Tables and other new features, and quotes him: 'It would be nice to see Confluent publish benchmarks and reference architectures for Lightning Tables.' He voiced a wish rather than making a formal request; the article's body quotes his words in full.

The article leaves unexplained why TechTarget dates IBM's acquisition of Confluent to December 2025 while the Herald reported completion on March 17, 2026. The sources cited in the Herald's earlier article show two events: TechCrunch reported on December 8, 2025 that IBM had agreed to acquire Confluent, and PR Newswire reported on March 17, 2026 that IBM had completed the acquisition. TechTarget does not say which event it means.

The article says Bond cited an IDC survey 'from earlier this year'. That is TechTarget's relative wording in an article published November 4, 2026, which gives no survey title or date; read it as a survey from earlier in 2026.
